<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Advisory Deal Flow</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues. However, each of you agreed that a standard submission time was acceptable for UK corporate, litigation, and advisory matters.

The best option will be to agree to a submission deadline of 4pm GMT each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many new instructions were received after 4pm London time. We had three Corporate Advisory matters, and two Cross-Border Litigation matters). After 4pm, the case management system would automatically assign new Corporate Advisory instructions to the next business day. However, for those instructions that do not roll over after 4pm, the various practice groups would need to remember that these matters are the following day's business. I am not sure how the procedures in the Compliance Department would need to be modified for the fee earner's caseload reports, as the official records would not include these late instructions. Can the Compliance Department run supplemental reports to ensure that the teams have accurate caseloads each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a submission deadline of 4pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle
x36557

Eric - any potential problems with the Daily Performance Review?
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
